responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the MIPS-specific RTL operand predicates used throughout mips.md and the included ASE/CPU description files. It classifies immediates, registers, memory forms, symbolic addresses, stack and cprestore slots, comparison operators, vector constants, and target-dependent special cases such as split relocations, MIPS16 restrictions, LL/SC synchronization operands, and MSA/DSP-related constants, providing the generated recog/reload machinery with the legal operand tests that distinguish MIPS addressing and encoding forms during instruction matching and expansion.
